rationale: The report largely follows an incident-report register (numbered sections, timestamps, passive phrasing, exhibits implied) but the narrative voice intrudes with wry descriptions and a blame slip in Board approval noting a member 'was operating the fireworks,' which undermines non-attribution.
quote: Board Approval: Approved unanimously, with one abstention (Board member was operating the fireworks and recused himself out of an abundance of caution, *not* an admission of fault).
